description.value: Kirkland House is a fully restored 1911 Edwardian farmhouse situated within over two acres of groomed gardens inside Hawthorne Grove Park in Ladner, maintained entirely by the volunteer-run Kirkland House Foundation. The site features heritage architecture, a gazebo built by Delta Secondary students, a model train room, and an agricultural display shed. Owned by the City of Delta and freely accessible to the public, it offers a genuine window into early 20th-century pioneer farm life in the Fraser Delta.
